hero.title: A school built on attention, not assembly lines
hero.text: Established in 2026, Leaders International School brings together our NECTA National Wing and Cambridge International Wing on a purpose-built campus in Kisakasaka, Zanzibar. We teach children to read widely, reason clearly, and lead with character.

missionVision.title: Our mission
missionVision.text: To give every learner an excellent, accessible and values-based education in Kisakasaka — taught in small classes across NECTA and Cambridge streams, measured honestly, and open to families of every background on Zanzibar.

missionVision.title: Our vision
missionVision.text: A generation of Zanzibari leaders who are fluent in science, languages, and their own culture, leaving primary school with the confidence to excel anywhere in the world.

missionVision.title: Our promise
missionVision.text: No child slips through unnoticed. Every pupil has a dedicated class teacher, a term-by-term learning plan, warm meals on campus, and daily character guidance.

values.title: Integrity
values.text: We tell students the truth about their work, and we tell parents the truth about theirs.

values.title: Excellence
values.text: Marks are not the only goal, but high standards are how character and curiosity are built.

values.title: Global-mindedness
values.text: NECTA and Cambridge curricula side by side; Swahili, English and Arabic on the same shelf.

values.title: Compassion
values.text: Daily Madrasa, moral reflection, and community care projects in our surrounding wards.

values.title: Respect & safety
values.text: A signed safeguarding policy, zero tolerance for bullying, and pastoral care on staff.

values.title: Community
values.text: Parents are partners, not customers. Our doors are open every week for parent conversations.

items.title: A Purpose-Built Campus in Kisakasaka
items.text: Construction and commissioning of our modern 4.2-hectare campus, complete with bright classrooms, science labs, ICT facility, and sports grounds.

items.title: Dual Curricula Accreditation
items.text: Full registration with the Ministry of Education Zanzibar, Tanzanian NECTA curriculum approval, and Cambridge Primary pathway integration.

items.title: Expert Teaching Faculty
items.text: Recruitment and rigorous onboarding of forty-two vetted educators and pastoral leads dedicated to small-class teaching.

items.title: January 2027 Inaugural Intake
items.text: Welcoming our foundational cohorts across Baby Class, Nursery (KG1 & KG2), NECTA Grades 1–6, and Cambridge Years 1–6.

leadership.title: Leadership team
leadership.lead: Our governance and academic leadership structure overseeing Early Years, NECTA National Primary, Cambridge International stream, and curriculum standards.

roles.focus: Institutional governance, strategic development, school policy, and purpose-built campus infrastructure oversight.
Baby Class and Nursery (KG1 & KG2) foundations: play-based phonics, numeracy, joyful discovery, and child wellbeing.
Grades 1 to 6 national curriculum standards, teacher supervision, NECTA examinations preparation, and moral character.
Cambridge Assessment International Education Primary (Years 1–6), inquiry learning, Cambridge Checkpoints, and global readiness.
Master timetabling, continuous assessments, subject department coordination, and examination moderation across both wings.

faculty.title: Who teaches your child
faculty.text: Forty-two full-time educators and teaching assistants across Pre-Primary, NECTA Primary, and the Cambridge Wing — qualified, vetted, and deeply committed to children.

departments.name: Baby Class & Nursery (KG1 & KG2)
departments.detail: Play-based phonics, early numeracy, creative arts, outdoor discovery, and two adults in every room.

departments.name: English, Literacy & Global Perspectives
departments.detail: Guided reading in Grades 1–6 & Cambridge Years 1–6, readers theatre, and public speaking.

departments.name: Mathematics & Science
departments.detail: Cambridge Primary Science & Maths, NECTA Science, weekly laboratory practicals, and robotics.

departments.name: Kiswahili, Arabic & Madrasa
departments.detail: Daily timetabled Madrasa, Qur'an recitation, moral studies, and Kiswahili heritage.

departments.name: Humanities & ICT
departments.detail: Social studies, Zanzibar history, digital literacy, and coding in our 34-seat computer lab.

departments.name: Art & Design, Music & Physical Education
departments.detail: Creative arts, ngoma ensemble, football, netball, athletics, and swimming.

accreditations.title: Ministry licensed
accreditations.text: Registered with the President's Office — Ministry of Education and Vocational Training, Zanzibar.

accreditations.title: Cambridge International Wing
accreditations.text: Offering Cambridge Assessment International Education Primary programme across Years 1–3 and Years 4–6.

accreditations.title: NECTA National Curriculum
accreditations.text: Approved centre for the Tanzanian National Examinations Council (NECTA) curriculum from Grade 1 to Grade 6.

accreditations.title: Safe-schools commitment
accreditations.text: Signed child-protection policy, vetted staff, first-aid trained office, and nutritious daily meals on site.
